nodes.text: Enter normal Stratholme through its main northern gate in Eastern Plaguelands, leading to Crusader’s Square. The service entrance’s separate Gauntlet wing is not the supported route.

recovery.text: Recheck the named room, selected difficulty and current game objectives. Continue advances only the guide cursor; it never records a kill, unlock, purchase or ownership.

nodes.text: Follow the living-side streets toward Market Row and Festival Lane. Pass the short portcullis passage; if the rat trap closes its gates, clear the rats and wait for them to reopen. Search the steps and building overhangs around Market Square for neutral Hearthsinger Forresten.

recovery.text: Use the dungeon map and his name to search both sides of the street. He has several possible positions and may be absent. Do not use pre-Cataclysm service-gate shortcuts or assume a spawn timer.

nodes.writtenDestination: Normal Stratholme, living main-gate wing: follow Market Row toward Festival Lane and Market Square. Search the street steps and building overhangs for neutral Hearthsinger Forresten.

nodes.text: Defeat Hearthsinger Forresten and loot Piccolo of the Flaming Fire if it drops. If absent or no drop, leave and choose a fresh normal run only when the client permits an instance reset.

recovery.text: This is a random drop in normal Crusader’s Square. A kill is not toy receipt. Instance limits and reset availability come from the game; no fixed attempt count or hourly quota is invented.

nodes.writtenDestination: Normal living-side Stratholme: Hearthsinger has several possible positions around the Market Row/Festival Lane streets and building overhangs; loot the neutral rare after defeating him.

nodes.text: Use Piccolo of the Flaming Fire from your bags to learn the toy.

recovery.text: Only Toy Box ownership finishes this goal. Loot, mail, an achievement and the guide cursor remain separate evidence.
